commands.command: /usr/bin/bash -lc "jq '{keys: keys, selected_rules: (.selected_rules|length), consulted_specs: (.consulted_specs|length), entity_repairs: (.entity_repairs|length), locations: ([.entity_repairs[].locations[]]|length), first: .entity_repairs[0]}' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json"

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'report_tmp=$(mktemp /workspace/.exp_agent/round_completion_01.json.XXXXXX) && jq '"' .entity_repairs |= map(with_entries(if .key == \"owning_entities\" then .key = \"entities\" elif .key == \"applicable_invariants\" then .key = \"invariants\" elif .key == \"repository_evidence\" then .key = \"evidence\" elif .key == \"transformation_summary\" then .key = \"transformation\" else . end))' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json > \""'$report_tmp" && mv "$report_tmp" .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json'

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq '{selected_rules: (.selected_rules|length), consulted_specs: (.consulted_specs|length), entity_repairs: (.entity_repairs|length), locations: ([.entity_repairs[].locations[]]|length), legacy_keys: ([.entity_repairs[] | keys[] | select(. == \"owning_entities\" or . == \"applicable_invariants\" or . == \"repository_evidence\" or . == \"transformation_summary\")]|length), invalid: ([.entity_repairs[] | select((.entities|type "'!= "array") or (.entities|length == 0) or (.invariants|type != "array") or (.invariants|length == 0) or (.evidence|type != "array") or (.evidence|length == 0) or (.transformation|type != "string") or (.transformation|length == 0) or .status != "repaired")]|length), first: .entity_repairs[0]}'"' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -S '[.[] | {relative_path, rule, line, column}] | sort_by([.relative_path, .rule, .line, .column])' .exp_agent/findings_round_01.json > /tmp/haprepair_findings_round01.json
jq -S '[.entity_repairs[] | .locations[] as "'$location | {relative_path, rule, line: $location.line, column: $location.column}] | sort_by([.relative_path, .rule, .line, .column])'"' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json > /tmp/haprepair_report_round01.json
if cmp -s /tmp/haprepair_findings_round01.json /tmp/haprepair_report_round01.json; then location_match=true; else location_match=false; fi
if jq -e '.entity_repairs | all(.[]; (.entities | type == \"array\" and length > 0) and (.invariants | type == \"array\" and length > 0) and (.evidence | type == \"array\" and length > 0) and (.transformation | type == \"string\" and length > 0) and .status == \"repaired\")' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json >/dev/null; then field_valid=true; else field_valid=false; fi
if jq -e '([.entity_repairs[] | keys[] | select(. == \"owning_entities\" or . == \"applicable_invariants\" or . == \"repository_evidence\" or . == \"transformation_summary\")] | length) == 0' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json >/dev/null; then legacy_absent=true; else legacy_absent=false; fi
jq -n --argjson lm \""'$location_match" --argjson fv "$field_valid" --argjson la "$legacy_absent" '"'{location_match: "'$lm, required_fields_valid: $fv, legacy_keys_absent: $la}'"'"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -S '[.rules[].rule] | sort | unique' .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json > /tmp/haprepair_plan_rules_round01.json
jq -S '.selected_rules | sort | unique' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json > /tmp/haprepair_report_rules_round01.json
jq -S '[.rules[] | {rule, files: [.files[] | {relative_path, locations}] }] | sort_by(.rule)' .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json > /tmp/haprepair_plan_groups_round01.json
jq -S '[.entity_repairs | group_by(.rule)[] | {rule: .[0].rule, files: (map({relative_path, locations}) | sort_by(.relative_path))}] | sort_by(.rule)' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json > /tmp/haprepair_report_groups_round01.json
if cmp -s /tmp/haprepair_plan_rules_round01.json /tmp/haprepair_report_rules_round01.json; then rules_match=true; else rules_match=false; fi
if cmp -s /tmp/haprepair_plan_groups_round01.json /tmp/haprepair_report_groups_round01.json; then groups_match=true; else groups_match=false; fi
jq '{selected_rules: .selected_rules, spec_rule_count: (.consulted_specs | length), unresolved_external: .unresolved_external}' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json
jq -n --argjson rm \""'$rules_match" --argjson gm "$groups_match" '"'{selected_rules_match: "'$rm, rule_file_groups_match: $gm}'"'"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -S '[.rules[] | {key: .rule, value: ([.semantic_spec.core_spec_path] + [.semantic_spec.families[].spec_path])}] | from_entries' .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json > /tmp/haprepair_plan_specs_round01.json
jq -S '.consulted_specs' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json > /tmp/haprepair_report_specs_round01.json
if cmp -s /tmp/haprepair_plan_specs_round01.json /tmp/haprepair_report_specs_round01.json; then specs_match=true; else specs_match=false; fi
jq -e 'type == \"object\" and (.selected_rules | length == 9) and (.consulted_specs | length == 9) and (.entity_repairs | length == 171) and ([.entity_repairs[].locations[]] | length == 485) and (.unresolved_external | length == 0)' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json >/dev/null
if [ \""'$?" -eq 0 ]; then report_integrity=true; else report_integrity=false; fi
jq -n --argjson sm "$specs_match" --argjson ri "$report_integrity" '"'{consulted_specs_match: "'$sm, report_integrity: $ri}'"'"
